import sys; sys.path.insert(0,str(WORK))
import numpy as np, json
from lsbuild import gelu, layer_data
from evalh import Lb, lab1, f1, stats
def LN(x,g,b): mu=x.mean(1,keepdims=True); v=x.var(1,keepdims=True); return (x-mu)/np.sqrt(v+1e-5)*g+b
pre='roberta.encoder.layer.5.'
ab,W1,b1,U,b2=layer_data(5,base)
g2=base(pre+'output.LayerNorm.weight').astype(np.float64); bb=base(pre+'output.LayerNorm.bias').astype(np.float64)
D=base('classifier.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bd=base('classifier.dense.bias').astype(np.float64); O=base('classifier.out_proj.weight').astype(np.float64); bo=base('classifier.out_proj.bias').astype(np.float64)
ae=np.load('a5e_1792.npy').astype(np.float64); Ge=gelu(ae@W1.T+b1)
keep=json.load(open('keep_F1792.json')); k5=keep['5']
Wl=W(pre+'output.dense.weight').astype(np.float64); bl=W(pre+'output.dense.bias').astype(np.float64)
he=LN(ae+Ge[:,k5]@Wl[:,k5].T+bl,g2,bb)
hb=np.load('pass_1/cls_hidden_L6.npy').astype(np.float64); Zb=hb@D.T+bd
folds=np.load('folds.npy'); pb=Lb.argmax(1); srt=np.sort(Lb,1); marg=srt[:,-1]-srt[:,-2]
L0=np.tanh(he@D.T+bd)@O.T+bo
print('no corr: agree',(L0.argmax(1)==pb).mean())
for lam in [3e2,1e3,3e3,1e4]:
  for seed in [0,1,2]:
    if seed==0: fo=folds
    else: fo=np.random.RandomState(seed).permutation(1000)%10
    Lcv=np.zeros_like(Lb,dtype=np.float64)
    for f in range(10):
        tr=fo!=f; te=fo==f
        X=he[tr]; mu=X.mean(0); Xc=X-mu; Y=Zb[tr]; ym=Y.mean(0)
        M=np.linalg.solve(Xc.T@Xc+lam*np.eye(768), Xc.T@(Y-ym)+lam*D.T).T; c=ym-M@mu
        Lcv[te]=np.tanh(he[te]@M.T+c)@O.T+bo
    pe=Lcv.argmax(1)
    print('lam',lam,'seed',seed,'agree %.3f low %.3f acc %.3f'%((pe==pb).mean(),(pe==pb)[marg<np.quantile(marg,.2)].mean(),(pe==lab1).mean()))
